the_day: OpenAI added teen safety limits, reversed a ChatGPT Pro usage cut and faced new lawsuits; a tampered Claude Code extension reached Cursor users; Meta began alerting parents about teens' self-harm searches; Google put ads in AI Overviews in more countries; and SpaceX offered to buy homes near an AI data center.

items.headline: Tampered Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace planted SSH backdoors
points: Security firms report that version 2.1.313 of the Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace installed persistent SSH backdoors on developer machines.
Reuters reports that Cursor says up to 5,000 users were affected.
Responsibility is in dispute: DoublePulsar says Anthropic was hacked, while The Register reports Anthropic says the compromise was not on its side.
items.for_you: Developers who installed the Claude Code extension through Cursor's marketplace should check whether they had version 2.1.313.
